content: Search PHP namespaces with grep -rlF 'App\Actions' -- fixed-string mode, no regex escaping. Backslash counting through shell quoting plus BRE silently produces a false zero, and a zero-hit result reads as proof of absence. When a grep returning nothing is about to become a claim that something is unused, re-run it a second way before writing the claim down.
context: During project setup I ran grep -rl 'App\\\\Actions' to test whether app/Actions was referenced and got zero hits, then reported the directory as dead. An independent Codex review found 10 live consumers including Auth/Login and Auth/Register. The single-quoted pattern reached grep as four backslashes, which BRE reads as two literal ones, so it searched for App\\Actions and matched nothing.
title: Use grep -F for PHP namespace searches
